description: This file defines the NativeToolCallParser class, which handles parsing, processing, and managing streaming chunks of native tool calls, including support for dynamic MCP tools, partial JSON parsing, and conversion of API file entries. It is central to interpreting tool call streams in an OpenAI-style function calling infrastructure.

classes.name: NativeToolCallParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing and managing native tool call streams, including chunk processing, event emission, and handling of dynamic MCP tools.

methods.name: processRawChunk
methods.description: Processes a raw chunk from the API stream, manages tracking, buffering, and emits start/delta/end events.

methods.name: processFinishReason
methods.description: Emits end events for all active tool calls when the stream finish reason indicates completion.

methods.name: finalizeRawChunks
methods.description: Finalizes any remaining raw chunks, emitting end events for unclosed tool calls.

methods.name: clearRawChunkState
methods.description: Clears all raw chunk tracking state, typically called at the start of a new stream.

methods.name: startStreamingToolCall
methods.description: Initializes tracking for a new streaming tool call with a given id and name.

methods.name: clearAllStreamingToolCalls
methods.description: Clears all active streaming tool call states.

methods.name: hasActiveStreamingToolCalls
methods.description: Checks if there are any active streaming tool calls.

methods.name: processStreamingChunk
methods.description: Processes a JSON chunk for a streaming tool call, returning a partial ToolUse object.

methods.name: finalizeStreamingToolCall
methods.description: Finalizes a streaming tool call, parsing the complete JSON arguments into a final ToolUse or McpToolUse.

methods.name: convertFileEntries
methods.description: Converts API file entries with various line range formats into FileEntry objects with lineRanges.

methods.name: createPartialToolUse
methods.description: Creates a partial ToolUse object from parsed arguments for streaming updates.

methods.name: parseToolCall
methods.description: Parses a native tool call object, handling dynamic MCP tools and alias resolution, returning a ToolUse or McpToolUse.

methods.name: parseDynamicMcpTool
methods.description: Parses a dynamic MCP tool call, extracting server and tool names, returning an McpToolUse object.
